Title: Stand-in Adventurer's Weapons
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Adventurer's Weapons folder name and
the shape of the hl2 ammo system it uses (item maxmag and ammotype fields, a
reserve per ammo type, ammo boxes, projectile headshot multipliers), so the
listed port applies to it. It is not the original Add-On and holds none of
its files, and its numbers are its own.
